continue_old.reason: Raw old commands preserve the native policy and use the remaining original queue; they do not participate in ten-step matched-radius comparison.
Critic was trained for 10-step interventions with fixed10 continuation; continue_old has a different continuation.

cost.interpretation: Worker-summed wall time is compute burden, not parallel elapsed time; native and matched candidates share generation calls. generation_wall_seconds includes source replay; candidate_bank_seconds excludes replay but includes context loading, candidate generation, scoring and persistence. Neither is an isolated post-policy deployment benchmark.

interpretation: Small fresh-source comparison in the same five MetaWorld tasks; nominal source-cluster intervals are exploratory and do not establish a stable winner or broad validation.
limitations: This small fresh-source comparison ranks frozen candidates within the current MetaWorld setup; it is not broad validation or proof of a winner.
Eight suffixes share one source; task-stratified bootstrap resamples sources, never suffixes.
Nominal 95% intervals across multiple registered comparisons are not multiplicity corrected.
Matched projection may expand or shrink native deltas; native outputs and reverse/random directions are generated but are not executed in this small batch.
A Q increase alone does not demonstrate real recovery or trustworthy local derivatives.
replan versus continue_old is a full policy comparison that includes interruption and fixed10 versus native50 cadence; it does not isolate the alarm action alone.
